about:
Wilkinson Koa Furniture operates from Pearl City, Hawaii, where founder Alan Wilkinson creates custom koa furniture from a workshop on Waihona Street. The business centers on Wilkinson’s expertise as a koa master, producing one-of-a-kind pieces commissioned by clients seeking heirloom-quality work. No founding year is publicly disclosed.

The shop produces a range of koa furniture including beds, cabinets, chairs, chests, desks, drawers, jewelry boxes, tables, and vanities. Each piece is handcrafted to order, with Wilkinson overseeing design and construction. The operation appears to be a small-scale studio; no facility size, headcount, or production volumes are published.

Clients are individuals and collectors who commission custom koa furniture for residential use. The company does not list specific industry sectors or commercial accounts, focusing instead on direct commissions for pieces intended to become family heirlooms.

Wilkinson emphasizes that every item is a unique masterpiece built with meticulous attention to detail and skill, using koa wood prized for its figure and durability. The founder’s background as an award-winning artist is cited as a differentiator, with the company noting that his work has earned numerous accolades.
